title: The sandbox may be used for testing
quote: We can reuse the sandbox for testing, but nothing else. The current intents board is legacy too: we learn from it and carry its lessons into the new avenCEO harness.
means: The sandbox may be used for testing; the Intents board is legacy, its lessons move into avenCEO.

supersedes.what: D-4 said nothing outside theOS is used; the sandbox may now be used for testing.

reflection.checked: every decision before D-5 that held
